alt: Five friends each give one gift. A list starts with every friend giving to themselves, then a Fisher-Yates shuffle swaps positions from the right end toward the left, each with a random earlier position. After the shuffle the list is checked: any friend who still gives to themselves is marked invalid and the whole shuffle is thrown away and repeated.

steps.caption: Try 1 starts with `gift[i] = i`: every friend gives to themselves. The shuffle fixes one position at a time, starting at position 4 and stopping at 1.
`random.randint(0, 4)` gives j = 1, so `gift[4]` and `gift[1]` swap. Position 4 is now finished.
`random.randint(0, 3)` gives j = 1, so `gift[3]` and `gift[1]` swap. Positions 3 to 4 are now finished.
`random.randint(0, 2)` gives j = 1, so `gift[2]` and `gift[1]` swap. Positions 2 to 4 are now finished.
`random.randint(0, 1)` gives j = 1, the same position, so `gift[1]` swaps with itself and stays 2.
Checking the finished shuffle: Friend 0 gives to themselves, so it is not valid. Throw it away and shuffle again.
Try 2 starts over from the same list, `gift[i] = i`.
`random.randint(0, 4)` gives j = 4, the same position, so `gift[4]` swaps with itself and stays 4.
`random.randint(0, 3)` gives j = 0, so `gift[3]` and `gift[0]` swap. Positions 3 to 4 are now finished.
`random.randint(0, 2)` gives j = 2, the same position, so `gift[2]` swaps with itself and stays 2.
`random.randint(0, 1)` gives j = 0, so `gift[1]` and `gift[0]` swap. Positions 1 to 4 are now finished.
Checking the finished shuffle: Friends 2 and 4 give to themselves, so it is not valid. Throw it away and shuffle again.
Try 3 starts over from the same list, `gift[i] = i`.
`random.randint(0, 4)` gives j = 3, so `gift[4]` and `gift[3]` swap. Position 4 is now finished.
`random.randint(0, 3)` gives j = 2, so `gift[3]` and `gift[2]` swap. Positions 3 to 4 are now finished.
`random.randint(0, 2)` gives j = 2, the same position, so `gift[2]` swaps with itself and stays 4.
`random.randint(0, 1)` gives j = 0, so `gift[1]` and `gift[0]` swap. Positions 1 to 4 are now finished.
Checking the finished shuffle: no friend gives to themselves. Try 3 is the answer, `1 0 4 2 3`, after 3 tries.
